parameters.jsCode: const source=$('Normalize Tasks Request').item.json||{}; const data=$json||{}; const ok=!data.error&&!data.message; const rows=Array.isArray(data.items)?data.items:[]; let text=''; if(rows.length) text=rows.slice(0,20).map((t,i)=>`${i+1}. ${t.title||'(untitled)'}${t.due?' | due '+t.due:''}${t.status?' | '+t.status:''}`).join('\n'); else if(ok) text=source.method==='GET'?'No matching tasks.':'Task action completed.'; else text=String(data.error?.message||data.message||'Google Tasks request failed.'); return [{json:{ok,tool:source.tool,text,result:data,links:[],meta:{requestId:source.requestId||''}}}];
